paragraphs.text: Anything you can screenshot can now be cloned in a weekend.
watched teams reverse-engineer paid products into open source with AI.
expects every AI harness to rebuild Slack, then Linear. Copying is the default move now.
shipped Stageshow, a skill that gets agents to produce good-looking UI. Surface quality became something you install.
drew the line plainly: people rebuild bad software themselves, but keep paying for good software because it keeps getting better.
That last part is the job. Not the screen, but the rate of improvement behind it. The calls you make in month nine, long after the clone stopped shipping.
Design the screen. Compound the judgment.
